name: Access Control Policy
description: Access to cardholder data must be restricted to authorized personnel based on business need-to-know.

name: Audit Logging
description: Logging mechanisms must be enabled to track all access to network resources and cardholder data.

name: Network Security
description: Firewall and router configurations must be established to protect cardholder data environments.

name: Data Backup
description: Backup procedures must be configured and tested to ensure recovery of cardholder data.

name: Remote Access Restriction
description: Remote access to cardholder data environments must be restricted and authenticated.
